reason: E2 shows that 70% cold rolling and rapid annealing (15 °C/s, 30–60 s) were applied to a related alloy, supporting the feasibility of the processing route, but neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence for the retention of metastable dual-phase regions, their role in toughness/ductility, or the specific 25% strength improvement in NbTaHfTiZrV0.5.
premises: Cold rolling to ~70% reduction can be applied to NbTaHfTiZrV0.5 to refine microstructure
Rapid annealing at 600–700 °C after cold rolling can produce partial recrystallization
Partial recrystallization can retain metastable dual-phase regions in this alloy
Retained metastable dual-phase regions enhance fracture toughness and maintain ductility
